versions.changelog:
Initial release of client-comms-drafter: draft professional client communications for freelancers.

- Drafts clear, ready-to-send client emails for project updates, scope changes, payment reminders, feedback, tricky conversations, and wrap-ups.
- Provides subject lines and follows situation-specific structures for each communication type.
- Defaults to UK English and a professional-warm tone, with customisation options.
- Enforces concise, focused messages with clear next steps and no blanks/placeholders.
- Offers 2–3 variations for sensitive topics so users can choose the right approach.
